services.name: Rowhouse front repointing
services.blurb: Rowhouse fronts raked and repointed with a mortar matched to the original joint color.

services.name: Marble step reset
services.blurb: Rocking marble steps lifted, given a new mortar bed and set back level and tight.

services.name: Formstone repair or removal
services.blurb: Cracked formstone patched to match, or taken off to show the brick underneath.

services.name: Party wall & parapet repair
services.blurb: Parapets and shared walls at the roofline rebuilt, where most rowhouse leaks start.

services.name: Chimney repair
services.blurb: Loose chimney brick relaid and crowns rebuilt so rain stops running inside the wall.

services.name: Lintels & arches
services.blurb: Rusted steel lintels replaced and sagging brick arches over windows rebuilt to shape.

services.name: Back & alley walls
services.blurb: The rear walls and alley garden walls that get the most weather, repointed or rebuilt.

services.name: Mortar analysis
services.blurb: A sample of your old mortar broken down so the new mix matches its strength and sand.

services.name: Brick cleaning
services.blurb: Soot and grime washed off with gentle methods that keep the brick face whole.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our rowhouse in Canton had joints washing out on the front. Nia took a mortar sample, matched the color, and repointed the whole face in nine working days. Neighbors keep asking who did it.
reviews.name: Tom B.

reviews.text: The marble steps were rocking and one had cracked. They reset all three on a new bed. The cracked one they pinned instead of replacing, which saved us real money.
reviews.name: Denise H.

reviews.text: We wanted to know what was under the formstone. They opened a test patch first, showed us the brick, and gave us prices to patch or remove. We removed it.
reviews.name: Kevin O.

reviews.text: Water was coming in at the top of the bedroom wall every storm. The parapet was the problem. Rebuilt the top courses and the stain has not come back.
reviews.name: Angela S.

reviews.text: The brick arch over our kitchen window had dropped and cracked. They shored it, rebuilt the arch and replaced the rusted lintel. Window opens again.
reviews.name: Luis M.

reviews.text: Our back wall faces the alley and took a beating. They repointed it and rebuilt the garden wall that was leaning into the alley. Clean job site every day.
reviews.name: Rita J.

proof.guarantee: If new mortar cracks or loosens within two years, we come back and repoint it at no charge.
